news.title: Apple Foldable iPhone Faces Delays After Testing Issues
news.summary: Apple's first foldable iPhone encounters technical challenges during engineering test production, potentially delaying its planned second-half 2026 launch due to higher-than-expected issues discovered during prototype evaluation.
key_points: Technical issues discovered during Engineering Test Production phase
Higher number of problems than expected affecting mass production readiness
Launch timeline may be pushed back from second half of 2026
Apple maintaining strict quality standards despite delays

news.title: World's Thinnest Foldable Phone Launched: Smart-Tech FoldSlim X1 Measures Just 4.9mm
news.summary: Smart-Tech unveils the FoldSlim X1, claiming the title of world's thinnest foldable smartphone at just 4.9mm when unfolded, featuring advanced aerospace-grade hinge technology and 8.1-inch 144Hz display.
key_points: Ultra-thin design at 4.9mm when unfolded sets new industry benchmark
Features 8.1-inch LTPO OLED main display with 144Hz refresh rate
Carbon-fiber hinge system rated for 500,000 folds
5000mAh battery with silicon-carbon technology and 100W fast charging
Expected price around $1,699 in international markets

news.title: India's Income Tax Department Launches AI Assistant 'Kar Saathi'
news.summary: Indian government launches AI-powered chatbot 'Kar Saathi' with new website to simplify tax filing, offering 24/7 bilingual support in Hindi and English for taxpayer assistance.
key_points: 24/7 AI-powered assistance available in Hindi and English
Simplified user-friendly portal with unified navigation
Comprehensive guidance tools including FAQs and tax calendar
Part of broader digital transformation in government services

news.title: Realme 16 5G Launching with 7000mAh Battery and Premium iPhone-Like Design
news.summary: Realme announces the 16 5G smartphone featuring industry-leading 7000mAh battery, dual 50MP cameras, and premium design, set to launch April 2 in India with six-year battery warranty.
key_points: Massive 7000mAh battery with 60W fast charging capability
Six-year battery warranty demonstrates confidence in longevity
Dual 50MP cameras (front and rear) with 'Selfie Mirror' design
IP66, IP68, and IP69 ratings for dust and water protection
Expected price under ₹30,000 in Indian market

news.title: Samsung Plans AI Features Across All Smartphones by 2026
news.summary: Samsung officially confirms integration of advanced AI features across nearly all smartphone models by 2026, focusing on on-device AI processing for improved privacy and performance.
key_points: Comprehensive AI integration across flagship, mid-range, and budget phones
Focus on on-device AI processing rather than cloud dependency
Enhanced privacy, reduced latency, and offline AI capabilities
Applications include smart cameras, real-time translation, and voice assistants

news.title: GSI Technology Stock Surges on AI Memory Breakthrough
news.summary: GSI Technology announces breakthrough in Gemini AI associative processing unit, causing stock to jump 15% as the technology shows superior performance in vector search and database acceleration for AI workloads.
key_points: Gemini AI platform demonstrates 10x better power efficiency than competitors
Targets generative AI applications where traditional DRAM falls short
Stock surged over 15% following the announcement
Positions GSI as potential supplier for next-gen data centers

news.title: AI Reshaping Global Jobs: Automation Cuts Traditional Roles While Tech Careers Surge
news.summary: Global job market undergoes profound transformation as AI and automation replace traditional roles while creating new opportunities in technology-driven sectors, requiring massive reskilling efforts worldwide.
key_points: Automation reducing demand for routine and predictable jobs
Surge in demand for data science, machine learning, and cybersecurity roles
Reskilling and upskilling becoming essential for workforce survival
Countries investing heavily in digital education and training programs

news.title: Infineon Achieves 300mm GaN Wafer Technology Breakthrough
news.summary: Infineon develops world's first 300mm GaN wafer technology for power electronics, enabling improved efficiency, smaller size, lighter weight, and lower costs for semiconductor chips.
key_points: 300mm wafers enable 2.3x more chips per wafer than 200mm
Leverages existing silicon manufacturing equipment for cost efficiency
Positions Infineon as leader in all three power semiconductor materials
Technology breakthrough unlocks full potential of gallium nitride

news.title: US Launches $250 Million Pax Silica Fund for Semiconductor Supply Chain
news.summary: U.S. Department of State announces $250 million fund to strengthen global semiconductor supply chains, focusing on critical minerals, infrastructure development, and manufacturing capabilities.
key_points: Aims to reduce vulnerabilities in global semiconductor ecosystem
Focuses on mining, processing, and infrastructure development
Part of broader strategy to secure technological leadership
Expected to reshape global supply chain dynamics

news.title: India's Startup Sector Enters New Era with 23% Funding Rise
news.summary: Indian startup ecosystem raises $9.1 billion in 2025, marking 23% year-over-year growth, with DeepTech and AI driving sustainable growth and profitability focus over rapid expansion.
key_points: Over 4,200 DeepTech startups with 550 new launches in 2025
AI accounts for 84% of DeepTech activity and 91% of funding
Shift from growth-at-all-costs to sustainable, profitable models
DeepTech sector attracted $2.3 billion, up 37% year-over-year
